It requires a fire source underneath to operate, such as a [[Campfire]] or [[Hearth]]. == Building == Cauldrons can be placed using the [[Hammer]], found under the Crafting tab. A fire does not need to be present to place a Cauldron, only to use/craft with it. The Cauldron recipe is unlocked only when the player picks up [[Tin]] for the first time after smelting it and has a [[Forge]] built. == Upgrades == Upgrading a Cauldron enables additional crafting recipes. '''Frost resistance mead''' is a [[Swamp]]-tier consumable item [[Fermenter|fermented]] from '''Mead base: Frost resistance'''. == Recipe == ''Mead base: Frost resistance'' is produced in a [[Mead Ketill]] with: *{{Item_Link|Honey|10}} *{{Item_Link|Thistle|5}} *{{Item_Link|Bloodbag|2}} *{{Item_Link|Greydwarf eye|1}} Six ''Frost resistance meads'' are produced by [[Fermenter|fermenting]] the mead base for two in-game [[Day and Night Cycle|days]]. == Effect == Consuming it grants Resistant VS Frost for 600 seconds (10 minutes), which prevents the [[Cold Effect|Cold]] and the [[Freezing Effect]]. It also reduces [[Damage types#Frost|Frost damage]] taken as detailed in [[Resistance]]. ==Notes== *A Frost resistance mead is typically necessary to craft before entering the [[Mountain]]s for the first time to prevent the [[Freezing]] effect, as the other common sources of Frost resistance require [[Silver]], [[Fenris Hair]] or [[Wolf Pelt]]s, which is only obtainable from the Mountains. *The Frost resistance mead, [[Wolf Fur Cape]], [[Wolf armor chest]], [[Fenris Coat]], [[Lox Cape]], and [[Feather Cape]] all provide the same resistance effect, and do not stack with each other. {{FoodsNav}} [[cs:Medovina proti mrazu]] [[ru:Морозоустойчивая медовуха]]

'''Whole Roasted Meadow Boar''' is the [[Meadows]]-tier [[Feast]].

==Recipe==
''Whole Roasted Meadow Boar'' can be produced at a [[Food Preparation Table]] with:
* {{item link|Cooked deer meat}} x2
* {{item link|Cooked boar meat}} x5
* {{item link|Dandelion}} x4
* {{item link|Woodland Herb Blend}} x1

==Trivia==
* Although most of the ingredients are found in the Meadows, the Woodland Herb Blend is only sold by [[The Bog Witch]] in the [[Swamp]] after [[The Elder]] has been defeated. So the feast will generally be acquired by players who are already at the Swamps stage.

'''Feasts''' are large meals that last longer and can be shared among several people. Feasts are crafted at the [[Food Preparation Table]] and require spices bought from [[The Bog Witch]]. Before being eaten, they must be placed using the [[Serving Tray]]. They can be placed on any surface, on the floor or on a table, this is done using the Serving Tray build menu to choose which feast to place. Once placed, the feast has 10 servings, and each serving lasts 50 minutes. When all servings are eaten, the empty platter must be removed using the Serving Tray's "Remove" function. If a feast has already been partially eaten, it yields nothing when destroyed or dismantled. Feasts are balanced foods, providing equal amounts of [[health]] and [[stamina]]. They are typically crafted from less than 10 meals, but provide 10 servings with twice the duration than most foods, effectively turning them into 20 servings, which makes them a worthwhile investment. == List of feasts == {| class="wikitable" |- !Name!!Icon!!Health!!Stamina!!Eitr!!Healing
